description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy or correlation scores for three different metrics—Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow), STS Correlation (pink), and Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue)—across four distinct model configurations along the horizontal axis: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy / Correlation” and spans from 0 to 0.8 on a linear scale, with gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Each model configuration has three adjacent bars representing the three metrics. For the Single-task_baseline, the Sentiment Acc. bar reaches approximately 0.53, the STS Corr. bar is around 0.51, and the Paraphrase Acc. bar is the highest at approximately 0.79. In the Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout group, Sentiment Acc. is approximately 0.52, STS Corr. is approximately 0.58, and Paraphrase Acc. is approximately 0.78. For Unsupervised_SimCSE, Sentiment Acc. is approximately 0.52, STS Corr. is approximately 0.71, and Paraphrase Acc. is approximately 0.77. In the final group, 2-Tier SimCSE, Sentiment Acc. is approximately 0.50, STS Corr. is approximately 0.81, and Paraphrase Acc. is approximately 0.78. The bars are grouped by model configuration and are not sorted; the 2-Tier SimCSE model shows the highest STS Corr. score, while the Single-task_baseline model shows the lowest STS Corr. score. The chart does not indicate any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding for specific bars.
